definitions.explanation: A feeling of being fed up with or thoroughly tired of something, leading to a desire to avoid it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{嫌気|いやけ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦さした→さする：20837_sasuru⟧。
examples.english: I got fed up with work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{残業|ざんぎょう}→残業：01071_zangyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{嫌気|いやけ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦さしている→さする：20837_sasuru⟧。
examples.english: I'm fed up with the daily overtime.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人間関係|にんげんかんけい}→人間関係：11462_ningenkankei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{嫌気|いやけ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦さして→さする：20837_sasuru⟧、⟦{田舎|いなか}→田舎：01320_inaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}した→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧。
examples.english: I grew so tired of human relationships that I moved to the countryside.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{嫌|いや}→嫌：10232_iya⟧ (unpleasant, disagreeable) + {気|け} (feeling, sense)

KEY PATTERN:
Almost always used with ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧さす: {嫌気|いやけ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧さす (to become disgusted with, to grow tired of). The pattern ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{嫌気|いやけ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧さす means "to get fed up with ~."

USAGE:
Stronger than ⟦{飽|あ}きる→飽きる：01815_akiru⟧ (to get bored of). {嫌気|いやけ} implies not just loss of interest but active aversion or revulsion toward something that has become intolerable.
Do not confuse with ⟦{嫌気性|けんきせい}→嫌気性：27751_kenkisei⟧ (anaerobic), where the reading is けんき.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {嫌気|いやけ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧さす: to get fed up, to feel disgusted
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{嫌気|いやけ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧さす: to grow tired of ~
- {嫌気|いやけ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦さして→さする：20837_sasuru⟧: being fed up (as a reason)
